invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new HoodieJavaWriteClient, so result is never null.
The returned instance is constructed with new HoodieJavaWriteClient, so it must be of that type.
The HoodieJavaWriteClient constructor takes config and context, so its getConfig() should return the same config.
The HoodieJavaWriteClient constructor uses context, so getEngineContext() should return the provided context.
